scope:
Decode matched sampler latents with the same FP32 CPU occupancy decoder.

Isolates sampler differences from TT decoder differences on one scene crop.
Reports numerical failures alongside occupancy overlap; no mesh-quality claim
or automatic quality promotion from an IoU value.
decoder_precision: Same official decoder, FP32 CPU for every latent; fixed zero threshold and original max-pool 2
finding: With the identical FP32 CPU decoder, the candidate and stock TT occupancies overlap at IoU 0.913 (4010 intersecting / 4394 union voxels). Against FP32 sampler occupancy, stock IoU is 0.509 and candidate 0.514. The candidate changes occupied topology; the small one-scene improvement against FP32 is not evidence of preserved or improved reconstruction quality.
decision: Keep both failed numerical trajectories visible and do not promote the speed optimization. Separate intended sampler precision from backend drift and assess geometry/material quality on more scenes.
limit: Single original poster crop, occupancy only, no shape/texture decoding or mesh. These are sampler-input effects through a common decoder; TT decoder errors are excluded. No automatic IoU acceptance threshold.
validation: 3 occupancy metric regression checks pass; full actual decoder outputs are finite and boolean grids retained.
